body:
GA cut-precondition reading for 18.1.0 · `domain:devx` seat 1 (seat post #6023) · `os-elon-musk` · `session_01LKHDniRQSWjRJyDtacwpEd` · 2026-10-23T00:47Z. ⛔ Not a release act: the seat does not refresh, approve, merge or publish. It also changes no labels. The maintainer asked for this reading. It covers the two GA-only items in `docs/releases-maintenance.md` (`:330`, `:446–450`): the **#7275-A cut precondition** and the **board-clearing pass**.

**Verdict: not clear.** Two precondition items fail and one board is unreadable. #24876 itself is current against `main`, but none of its CI has run yet.

### The rule being read

- #7275, maintainer ruling `5237208028` (2026-08-10), verbatim: "Before a cut, the release protocol takes the pin readout once; if the pin lags, the console bump card must exist and be boarded (`target:v17`) or explicitly waived with the standard accepted-for-GA comment."
- Standing text, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md` 「发版板运维」 on `origin/main` `9dc1f42d50`:
  - `:89` 「发版前置:清板动手之前先取一次 pin 读数,⛔ 一次即止不是重扫。」
  - `:90` 「pin 滞后 ⇒ console bump 单必须已存在且已上板,或按标准形态明示接受。」
  - `:91` 「两者都不成立 ⇒ ⛔ 不 cut。」
  - `:83` 「归零 = 可发版指三张板都空,单看主仓归零不是。」
  - `:86–87`: each board item takes one of three dispositions: fix it, take it off the board, or accept it explicitly. Explicit acceptance means removing the label, posting an accepted-for-GA comment, and listing the item under known issues in the release notes.
- The major for 18.1.0 is 18, so the board label is `target:v18`.

### 1. Pin readout (#7275-A), taken once

| reading | command | result | read at |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| committed pin | `git show origin/main:.objectui-sha` (main `9dc1f42d50`) | `0d12e95361b2`, moved by #25262 (`cc8d886d40`) | 2026-10-23T00:43Z |
| objectui `main` | `git ls-remote https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui refs/heads/main` | `5fef032b1ada` | 2026-10-23T00:46Z |
| lag | `git rev-list --count 0d12e95361b2..origin/main` in objectui; `merge-base --is-ancestor` holds | **2 commits behind** | 2026-10-23T00:43Z |
| what the lag carries | `git diff --name-only 0d12e95361b2 origin/main -- .changeset/` | `b911ebb` objectui#13323 (#13328): `.changeset/13323-one-read-per-open.md`, `@object-ui/react` minor + `@object-ui/app-shell` patch (a nav entry and a page element bound to the same API read make one request per open). `5fef032` objectui#13327 (#13329): CI only, empty changeset | 2026-10-23T00:43Z |
| console bump card or PR | every open issue and PR in objectstack (124), matched on `pin\|bump\|objectui-sha` and on `objectui\|console`; open PRs (16) read by title and branch | **none** | 2026-10-23T00:44Z |
| explicit waiver | accepted-for-GA comments on this PR and on the board cards | **none** | 2026-10-23T00:46Z |

**Reading: the pin lags. No bump card exists, and the lag has no waiver ⇒ `:91`, ⛔ no cut until one of the two holds.** This is not a currency gate (#10134 removed those, and a lagging pin is not a defect in itself). The rule asks only that the shipped console revision be a recorded decision, either a boarded bump or a waiver.

### 2. Board-clearing pass (`label:target:v18 is:open`, three boards)

| board | query | result | read at |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| objectstack | `GET repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues?labels=target:v18&state=open` | **2**: #15194 (`[epic]` ADR-0131, `tracking`, `pm:epic`) and #15212 (C8 parent, `pm:blocked`) | 2026-10-23T00:41Z |
| objectui | `GET repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues?labels=target:v18&state=open` | **0** | 2026-10-23T00:41Z |
| cloud | `GET repos/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues?labels=target:v18&state=open` | **not readable by this seat** (HTTP 403) | 2026-10-23T00:41Z |

- **Neither objectstack item has a disposition.** Each has had `target:v18` since 2026-09-04 (label events: `hotlong`, 2026-09-04T05:44Z and 2026-09-04T06:06Z). Both were still on the board when 18.0.0 shipped. Neither carries an accepted-for-GA comment.
- **What they hold now.** The epic seat's reconciliation on #15212 (`6339761793`, 2026-10-22T11:35Z) says every planned step of the 18.x line is closed. The remaining scope is child cards #25201, #25202, #25208, #25203 and #25204, and none of them is on the board. The line rules (`6266750393`, `6270035914` on #15194) keep `main` releasable after every merge.
- **Not on any board, for completeness:**
  - hotcrm is not one of the protocol's three boards and has no `target:*` label.
  - objectstack also carries a stray `target:18` label (no `v`) with 0 open items.
- **Reading: the board is not cleared.** The objectstack board has 2 items without a disposition, and the cloud board could not be read. The maintainer chooses each disposition. Under `:86`, an item the cut does not wait for is either taken off the board or accepted explicitly. It does not stay on the board in silence.

### 3. Is #24876 current, and has its CI run?

| reading | command | result | read at |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `main` tip | `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` | `9dc1f42d50` (#25307, committed 2026-10-22T23:55Z) | 2026-10-23T00:46Z |
| head | `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/changeset-release/main` | `a93805a2e1`, parent `9dc1f42d50`, rendered by the scheduled Release run `39877864123` (2026-10-23T00:23Z, success) | 2026-10-23T00:46Z |
| behind `main` | `git rev-list --count $(git merge-base origin/main a93805a2e1)..origin/main` | **0** | 2026-10-23T00:44Z |
| changesets consumed | `.changeset/*.md` count on `main` and on head | 191 → 0. `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0 → **18.1.0**. Head pin = `main` pin | 2026-10-23T00:44Z |
| check-runs on head | `GET .../commits/a93805a2e1/check-runs` | **total 0**. Commit status: `publish-smoke / packed-tarballs` success (1/1) | 2026-10-23T00:44Z |
| workflow runs on head | `GET .../actions/runs?head_sha=a93805a2e1` | **15 `pull_request` runs, all `action_required`** (CI, Lint & Type Check, Scaffold E2E, Spec Liveness, …). `mergeable_state: blocked` | 2026-10-23T00:44Z |
| `main` CI on `9dc1f42d50` | same query, head_sha `9dc1f42d50` | `merge_group` CI, Lint, Spec Liveness and Governed Surface: success. `push` CI: in progress | 2026-10-23T00:45Z |

**Reading: the version PR is current and no refresh is needed now.** If anything lands on `main` before the merge, including a pin bump from §1, the PR goes stale. A merge of a stale PR ships that code while its changesets stay pending, which is the #21361 class. **No check has run on this head.** On #24524 the PR checks ran as attempt 2, started by `os-zhuang` at 2026-10-20T11:10Z. This head needs the same approval.

### What the maintainer does next (every step is the maintainer's; the seat takes no release act)

1. **Pin (#7275-A).** Pick one:
   - **(a)** Waive. Post an explicit accepted-for-GA comment that names `0d12e95361b2` as 18.1.0's console. That means 18.1.0 ships without objectui#13323, and #13327 is CI-only.
   - **(b)** Bump. Have a console bump card filed and boarded `target:v18`. The triage seat boards it, as the single producer for this backlog. Land the bump PR (`scripts/bump-objectui.sh`) before the cut, then go to step 4.
2. **Board.** For #15194 and #15212, choose one of: fix, take off the board, or accept explicitly. Accepting means removing the label, posting an accepted-for-GA comment, and listing the item under known issues.
3. **Cloud board.** Read `label:target:v18 is:open` on objectstack-ai/cloud, or have the cloud seat read it. Then dispose of each item as in step 2.
4. **Refresh if `main` moved.** If `main` has moved past `9dc1f42d50`, run **Actions → Release → Run workflow** with **`refresh_version_pr` checked**. That is the bookkeeping lane only, with no publish. Wait for the refreshed PR.
5. **CI.** Approve the pending workflow runs on this PR and wait for green.
6. **Changelog.** Review the generated changelogs on this PR.
7. **Merge and approve.** Merge this PR. Then approve the `release` environment deployment, `Publish 18.1.0 to npm (awaiting approval)`.
8. **Re-read before merging.** This reading is a snapshot. If time passes before the merge, re-read §1 and §3 first.

Not measured: the cloud board (no read access from this seat).

Ruling: batch #2 item 5 · 5a B · 5b A · 5c A · maintainer 「卡 5 同意」 2026-10-23T02:08:04Z

Context: the Devx seat's GA-precondition reading 6354671079 (batch #1 item 3A = 18.1.0 GA through this PR) found two GA preconditions unmet, one board unreadable and CI unapproved. Ruled per item:

- **5a (#7275-A pin readout) = B, bump before the cut.** `.objectui-sha` `0d12e95361b2` lags objectui `main` `5fef032b1ada` by two commits (`b911ebb` = objectui#13323 fix, merged by #13328; `5fef032` CI only). No waiver: the devx seat files the console bump card, boards it on `target:v18`, dispatches the bump PR (`scripts/bump-objectui.sh`), and after it lands this version PR is refreshed (`refresh_version_pr`). 18.1.0 ships with #13323.
- **5b (`target:v18` board: #15194, #15212) = A, taken off the board.** Both have carried `target:v18` since 09-04 with no disposition; the epic seat's reconciliation 6339761793 shows the 18.x-line steps landed and the five remaining sub-cards are not boarded. The devx seat removes `target:v18` from both; the cards stay open until the epic's close-out; sub-cards that belong on the board go through triage.
- **5c (cloud release board) = A now, C later.** objectstack-ai/cloud is not readable by this project's seats; the maintainer reads the board himself and reports the count; adding the cloud repository to the project's resources closes that blind spot for later GA readings.
- **5d (CI approval)**: the 15 `action_required` runs are approved once, by the maintainer or os-zhuang, after 5a lands and this PR sits at its final head; approving now would have to be repeated.

Release actions (refresh, CI approval, merge, `release` environment approval) stay the maintainer's; the seat does not perform them. hotcrm's 18.1.0 bump and hotcrm#2230 follow GA; hotcrm v5.2.0 does not wait (batch #1 item 4A).
